Local FlightSim modifications, 2026-10-08

This is a modified local bevy_core_pipeline 0.18.1, not a pristine registry
package. src/tonemapping/mod.rs omits the AgX LUT embedding and explicitly
rejects AgX render selection at HDR specialization and shared LUT bindings.
The AgX KTX2 source payload is omitted. Exact TonyMcMapface and Blender Filmic
payloads, decoding/sampling settings and shader source remain unchanged.

The changes are provided under the project's existing MIT OR Apache-2.0 terms.
Upstream licence texts and retained-code notices are preserved. Supplemental
asset notices are in third-party-notices. The package's code licence expression
does not replace these asset-specific terms. No new AgX grant, human authorship,
upstream endorsement or qualification for publication is asserted.

See FLIGHTSIM-PATCHES.md and FLIGHTSIM-UPSTREAM-SOURCE.json for exact scope and
upstream archive/member provenance. The original .crate archive and omitted
AgX payload are not included in this source subset.
